title: CLAUDE.md Modular Architecture
description: Split monolithic CLAUDE.md (726 lines) into modular, path-based conditional loading. Fix stale counts across all 5 CLAUDE.md files. Based on Reddit modular architecture insights.

units.title: Audit Current CLAUDE.md Files

steps.instruction: Read all 5 CLAUDE.md files and catalog their sections
Identify stale data (counts, milestone numbers, action counts)
Classify each section as core (always needed), domain (context-specific), or scaffold (temporary patch)
Map which sections are relevant to which file paths

exit_conditions: Classification table of all sections with core/domain/scaffold labels

units.title: Extract Core Rules

steps.instruction: Create mcp-server/.claude/ directory structure if needed
Extract safety laws (S(x) hard block, no placeholders, etc.) into core hard-walls
Extract build instructions into core
Keep core rules under 200 lines total

exit_conditions: Core rules file exists with safety laws + build instructions

units.title: Extract Domain-Specific Rules

steps.instruction: Move engine conventions (AtomicValue, calculation patterns) into engines/CLAUDE.md
Move dispatcher conventions (parameter normalization, action routing) into dispatchers/CLAUDE.md
Move orchestration/swarm rules into a dedicated context file
Move registry counts and data sections into a data context file

exit_conditions: Each domain file is self-contained and under 100 lines

units.title: Identify and Remove Scaffolds

steps.instruction: Identify rules that patch model limitations vs encode permanent knowledge
Remove or archive scaffolds that are no longer needed with current model capabilities
Document remaining scaffolds with expiry criteria

exit_conditions: Scaffold inventory with rationale for keep/remove decisions

units.title: Fix All Stale Counts

steps.instruction: Update mcp-server/CLAUDE.md: 54/80 -> 61/90 milestones, 684 -> 1060 actions, etc.
Update dispatchers/CLAUDE.md: 684 -> 1060 actions
Update engines/CLAUDE.md: 74 -> 171 engines
Update root CLAUDE.md if any counts are referenced
Verify all counts match QA-verified values from MEMORY.md

exit_conditions: All 5 CLAUDE.md files have correct counts matching QA-verified reality

steps.instruction: Verify total token count of new modular system vs old monolith
Verify each file loads only when relevant paths are touched
Update MASTER_INDEX.md with new CLAUDE.md architecture
Run a test session to verify rules load correctly
